text:
If you're heading onto Lake Champlain this afternoon, take the Lake Wind Advisory seriously: south winds are running 15 to 25 knots, with waves around 1 to 3 feet. On land, Sunday is playing out just as advertised, a chilly start giving way to full sun, 54 now with a high near 55 and a steady south breeze. It'll stay bright through sunset at 6:03, but the breeze will keep it feeling more like fall than a warm afternoon.

The sky stays clear tonight, with a low near 39 and the south wind hanging around 12 mph. Monday is the warmer, easier outdoor day, full sun with a high right around 61 and lighter winds, though the lake will remain choppy early. Enjoy the waterfront from shore today, but I wouldn't take a small boat out this afternoon, and bring a jacket for any evening plans.
